events.verdict: Poole (WAS) grazes Capela's (ATL) arm and the contact does not affect his dunk attempt.
Poole (ATL) deflects the ball and is the last player to touch it before it goes out of bounds.

Coulibaly (WAS) extends his arm and initiates illegal contact to Young's (ATL) arm during his side-to-side motion. A non-shooting foul is correctly called because Young is not considered to be in his shooting motion at the time of the illegal contact.

Capela (ATL) jumps and maintains a legal vertical position while contesting Kispert's (WAS) driving shot attempt. He absorbs the contact to the body and appears to graze Kispert's elbow, which is marginal.
Risacher (ATL) legally contests Poole's (WAS) jump shot attempt.
George (WAS) maintains a legal forearm against Johnson's (ATL) body as he drives to the basket and the contact during the shot attempt should be deemed incidental.
George (WAS) places a forearm against Young's (ATL) body, but makes contact to Young's off-arm that affects his SQBR as he attempts to gather.
Risacher (ATL) commits a take foul on Poole (WAS).
George (WAS) deflects the throw-in out of bounds.
Poole (WAS) legally contests Daniels' (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Mathews (ATL) commits a take foul on Kispert (WAS).
Atlanta is correctly assessed a delay-of-game violation.
Coulibaly (WAS) legally contests Young's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
